ModMetaData.name: Shared Joys
ModMetaData.author: Blues
ModMetaData.description: Shared Joys allows your colonists to actively invite each other to hang out, relax, or sweep their lovers off their feet for a romantic break. Features: • Group Recreation: Select a colonist and invite friends to share a recreation spot. • Sweep Off Feet: Physically carry a lover to chill. • Automated Scheduling: Configure specific hours where colonists will autonomously organize group hangouts. • Highly Customizable: Tweak friendship thresholds, proximity limits, recreation duration and more. [url=https://github.com/khaiku/SharedJoys]Source code on GitHub[/url]
